warning: Can hide unequal recovery across groups.

warning: Requires clear definition of essential service.

warning: Can obscure local context and power.

Number of critical dependencies for a system or function.

warning: Coverage does not guarantee trust or action.

Proxy measure for trust legitimacy and cooperation.
